/elementProperties/actionScript.value:
global gEditMode, gAppliA, gActiveScrollers, gDebug
on mouseUp
if gActiveScrollers[the uMaster of me] is not empty then
delete variable gActiveScrollers[the uMaster of me]
else
end if
local tDataA
if gEditMode then pass mouseUp
set_a_variable "gAppliA sisID","field cs control 97a93e98-a1ee-4a71-8eb0-8de3a072c2cc"
query_records "Students","sisStudentID","=","gAppliA sisID","Cloud","recordData","gAppliA studentRecordA"
if appliI_GetUserVariableValue("studentRecordA") = "" then
answer_Dialog "Make sure your studentID is correct and try again.","OK","Choice2","Choice3","Output","Title","interfaceColor","interfaceTextColor","iconID"
exit mouseUp
end if
show_Loading "Authenticating ... One Moment"
get_list_of_keys "gAppliA studentRecordA","gAppliA studentRecordID"
get_Array_Value "gAppliA studentRecordA","gAppliA studentRecordID","email","gAppliA studentEmail"
get_auth "gAppliA studentEmail","field cs control 5072a846-8883-4f1d-a85f-51c5bec71487"
get_auth_status "gAppliA authedStatus","Cloud"
if appliI_GetUserVariableValue("authedStatus") = "true" then
set_a_variable "gAppliA studentContext_QuestionLineNumber","1"
set_a_variable "gAppliA passwordTemp","field cs control 5072a846-8883-4f1d-a85f-51c5bec71487"
set_a_variable "gAppliA emailTemp","gAppliA studentEmail"
get_logged_in_user "gAppliA authedUser"
liveCode_integration "8cd3de4f-5546-42f6-9900-0e9c34d415e9"
// liveCode_integration "5f2e5ed5-f0f9-410b-9fff-922e898ba6ef"
put "false" into tDataA["ignoreEmpty"]
put "StudentID" into tDataA["query"]["query 1"]["key"]
put "=" into tDataA["query"]["query 1"]["operator"]
put "gAppliA authedUserID" into tDataA["query"]["query 1"]["value"]
put "IsActive" into tDataA["query"]["query 2"]["key"]
put "=" into tDataA["query"]["query 2"]["operator"]
put "true" into tDataA["query"]["query 2"]["value"]
put "LiveCloudQuizlis" into tDataA["tableName"]
put "AND" into tDataA["logic"]
put "query 1,logic 1,query 2" into tDataA["order"]
batch_query_records "LiveCloudQuizlis",tDataA,"Cloud","recordData","gAppliA studentContext_Record"
put empty into tDataA
if appliI_GetUserVariableValue("studentContext_Record") = "" then
hide_Loading
answer_Dialog restoreLineBreaksInInput("~appli~Sorry~appli/comma~ no active Quizli was found."),"OK","Choice2","Choice3","Output","Title","interfaceColor","interfaceTextColor","iconID"
exit mouseUp
else
get_list_of_keys "gAppliA studentContext_Record","gAppliA studentContext_RecordID"
get_key_from_variable "gAppliA studentContext_Record","gAppliA studentContext_RecordID","gAppliA studentContext_Record"
get_Array_Value "gAppliA studentContext_Record","RecordIDs","/TeacherID","gAppliA studentContext_TeacherID"
combine_the_values "StudentAnswers","_","gAppliA studentContext_TeacherID","gAppliA authedUserTable_StudentAnswers"
get_Array_Value "gAppliA studentContext_Record","RecordIDs","/SessionID","gAppliA studentContext_SessionID"
put "false" into tDataA["ignoreEmpty"]
put "query 1" into tDataA["order"]
put "StudentAnswers_87534f99-d0a1-4e65-8d65-d3d592af5622" into tDataA["tableName"]
put "SessionID" into tDataA["query"]["query 1"]["key"]
put "=" into tDataA["query"]["query 1"]["operator"]
put "gAppliA studentContext_SessionID" into tDataA["query"]["query 1"]["value"]
batch_query_records "gAppliA authedUserTable_StudentAnswers",tDataA,"Cloud","recordData","gAppliA studentContext_StudentAnswerRecordsA"
put empty into tDataA
get_Array_Value "gAppliA studentContext_Record","RecordIDs","/ContextData/QuestionsText/","gAppliA studentContext_QuestionsText"
get_Array_Value "gAppliA studentContext_Record","RecordIDs","/QuestionIDs","gAppliA studentContext_QuestionsIDs"
get_Array_Value "gAppliA studentContext_Record","RecordIDs","/QuizID","gAppliA studentContext_QuizID"
count_Lines_In_Variable "gAppliA studentContext_QuestionsText","gAppliA studentContext_NumberOfQuestions"
end if
hide_Loading
go_to_screen "87666151-2394-4255-95a1-6cd099d0de4d"
else
hide_Loading
answer_Dialog "That email / password did not work","OK","Choice2","Choice3","Output","Title","interfaceColor","interfaceTextColor","iconID"
end if
if gActiveScrollers[the uMaster of me] is not empty then
else
pass mouseUp
end if
end mouseUp
